text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #18801 is failing CI on macOS shard with a tiny snapshot flicker. Can someone help with a quick rerun or approve if it's just a visual noise? @maria @kevin
ci-bot: Build 18801 failed on shard macos-3 — snapshot mismatch detected. Log: https://ci.example.com/builds/18801 (renders show a 1px shadow offset). To rerun: /rebuild or targeted: `bk rerun --shard macos-3`
kevin: Can we avoid updating snapshots unless we've confirmed it's nondeterministic? If it's UI timing, rerun first.
maria: I skimmed the diff — looks like a subpixel shift, probably nondeterministic from the renderer. I can approve a snapshot update if QA signs off, but prefer a rerun first.
jordan: Agreed. I'll trigger a targeted rerun now. If it passes 2x in a row, we merge and monitor; if it fails again, we'll open a small snapshot PR and tag design/qa.
sam: Triggered targeted rerun: `bk rerun --shard macos-3 --build 18801` — kicked off build 18801-rc2 https://ci.example.com/builds/18801-rc2 :eyes:
ci-bot: Rerun started for build 18801-rc2 (macos-3). ETA ~6m.
ci-bot: Rerun completed — macos-3 passed.
jordan: Rerun passed once. I'll rerun one more time to be safe.
sam: Second rerun queued: build 18801-rc3.
ci-bot: build 18801-rc3 (macos-3) passed.
maria: Both reruns green — I'm okay with merging. I'll approve the PR now. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks all — merging in 10m during the merge window. If anything flakey crops up, we'll revert and follow the snapshot PR path.
kevin: Thanks for the quick coordinated reruns everyone.
maria: leaving a note for QA to monitor the UI suite for two deploy cycles.
